findings.note: Mechanical pass on the audited bytes: key set and order equal English (74); ICU parse OK in intl-messageformat; argument names/types equal English per key; every plural arm set equals the locale's CLDR cardinal categories (Intl.PluralRules), =0 arm of results_title kept; no bidi control characters (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no em/en dashes; copy_scan.py 0 findings.

Naming rule: teammate (person) and agent stay distinct words in intro, unknown_sender and the result/refusal lines; Team Bridge, Touch ID, Mac and Local Operator untranslated. Approve/Deny/Approved/Denied match the shipped chat approval card (ui.chat.approval.option.*) and ui.mesh approvals renderings.

Pre-existing, out of scope: the teammate word follows ui.teamBridgeTrial, while the shipped ui.teamBridge namespace uses a 'team member' phrase. That split predates this PR; a glossary row for 'teammate' would settle it. Not gating.

Translator flag (many arms): fr many = exact multiples of 10^6 only, per the fr style guide ('# de sessions'). Adjective-only arms ('{count} de sélectionnées', 'de traitées', 'de non envoyées') follow the shipped audited precedent ui.settings.imports.selected; unreachable here (batch cap 50). Accepted.

Translator flag: 'Déjà répondu' is the idiomatic impersonal form; 'répondre à' is intransitive, so feminine agreement ('répondue') would be wrong. Reads correctly in the result line 'Priya · Approuver · Déjà répondu'. Accepted.
Punctuation: every ':' ';' preceded by U+202F; apostrophes U+2019; ellipsis U+2026.
Cancel button name 'Annuler' equals macOS LocalAuthenticationUI SHEET_AUTH_CANCEL for fr (measured from the system Localizable.loctable on this Mac).
